cites.quote: S-4: covered by the API order/envelope and invalid-status tests and the web table/filter test.
Given a doctor's list with 21 matching appointments, when staff open page 1, then the table shows 20 rows and the 21st appointment appears on page 2.

findings.text: S-2 AC1 and S-4 AC2 need 21 matching appointments (20 rows on page 1, 21st on page 2). The fixture has 5 rows, so page 2 is empty and no test checks 20-row paging or a page-2 row in the counts, yet the artifact lists S-4 and S-2 AC1 as covered.
